headline: Extended Beverly Farms Cemetery Fence MOU to May 29, 2026, and reviewed Round 13 funding applications.
summary: The Committee reviewed updates on Round 12 projects and discussed the budget available for Round 13 applications, which include park renovations, a fire sprinkler system, and housing trust funding. Members raised questions about several applications, including cost details, scope of work, and HDC review, and agreed to invite the Affordable Housing Trust and Housing Authority to the next meeting. The Committee voted to extend the MOU for the Beverly Farms Cemetery Fence project.
decisions: Approved extending the R10-4 Beverly Farms Cemetery Fence MOU to May 29, 2026, 7-0.
